## Core scientific distinctions / falsifiability
- Extreme heat `T_a(t)` is common external forcing, **not** cross-system transfer.
- Direction 1, **conditional** P→T_e: Transformer thermal state → applicable protection/control operating restriction (only if evidenced) → AC supply/charging capability → separately justified mobility service consequence.
- Direction 2, **conditional** T_e→P: EVSE/battery thermal/control states → actual charger operational response → independently measured GRID-side AC V,I,P,Q (phase and harmonic conventions when applicable) → transformer load/loss/temperature response. EVSE derating may **reduce**, not increase, transformer losses.
- Actual physical parameters, constraint thresholds, control law, heat durations, baseline electrical results, paired heat counterfactual and observed service outcomes remain `OPEN`/`NOT_RUN`.
- Full inventory 19 P +21 T_e remains a traceable coverage ledger; the active mechanism is the minimum sufficient subsystem, not the complete system.

## Native-presentation implementation
- One presentation-level question and two independently labeled candidate paths.
- Large directional arrows only between mechanism stages. White interiors, no colored background. Native editable labels, citations and physical boundaries.
- On-click reveal targets identify eight native shape objects. Programmatic XML validation is **STRUCTURAL_PASS**; actual Microsoft PowerPoint playback is **NOT_RUN**.
- Source images are NOT INCLUDED; equipment realism/photo integration remains `OPEN`, pending qualified and licensable/original equipment assets.
- Released prototype must retain `PROVISIONAL` until independent physics, rights, full-slide output QA and animation playback checks pass.
